2608.03588.title: GenOS: Compositional Certificates for Semantic Robustness in AI Code Generation
2608.03588.paper_summary: AI coding agents are stochastic workflows: prompts are interpreted, artifacts are sampled, validators produce observations, and orchestrators commit or repair. Small prompt or specification changes can therefore alter program-behavior distributions even when the texts appear synonymous. Existing systems evaluate correctness, but lack a compositional criterion for safely replacing a prompt, contract, generator, or program inside a complete agentic workflow. We introduce GenOS, a probabilistic operational semantics for this replacement problem. Each layer is modeled as a Markov kernel, and each interface carries an observer-relative equivalence. We prove that equivalence-compatible kernels descend to quotient classes and that quotienting commutes with distributional extension and sequential composition. Hence, equivalent prompts induce equal probabilities for all downstream equivalence-closed events, including verified commit. We also establish workflow bisimulation, guarded-commit safety under sound validation, total-variation non-expansiveness, and an additive robustness bound that attributes approximation error to individual pipeline layers. An executable insertion-sort audit instantiates the theory with natural-language paraphrases, a formal contract, six programs, two observers, and exhaustive execution on 121 inputs. Equivalent prompts yield identical code-class and commit distributions; a prompt assigning 5% probability to an in-place contract is distinguished by a mutation observer, while downstream distances remain within the predicted bound. Across 20,000 randomized finite-kernel trials, no exact or approximate law is violated. GenOS is model-parametric: compatibility is a measurable property to test, not an assumption about language-model behavior.
2608.03588.paper_summary_zh: AI 編碼代理是隨機工作流程：提示被解釋，工件被取樣，驗證者產生觀察，協調者進行提交或修復。<lb/>因此，即使文本看似同義，小的提示或規範變更也可以改變程序行為分佈。<lb/>現有系統評估正確性，但缺乏安全替換提示、合約、生成器或完整代理工作流程內程序的組合標準。<lb/>我們介紹 GenOS，一種針對這一替換問題的概率操作語義。<lb/>每一層被建模為馬爾可夫核，每個介面都攜帶觀察者相對的等價性。<lb/>我們證明了等價兼容的核會降至商類，且商化與分佈擴展和序列組合是可交換的。<lb/>因此，等價的提示對所有下游等價封閉事件（包括經過驗證的提交）產生相等的概率。<lb/>我們還建立了工作流程雙模擬、在健全驗證下的受限提交安全性、總變異非擴展性，以及一個加性穩健性界限，將近似誤差歸因於單個管道層。<lb/>一個可執行的插入排序審計用自然語言的同義改寫、正式合約、六個程序、兩個觀察者，以及對 121 個輸入的全面執行來實例化理論。<lb/>等價的提示產生相同的代碼類別和提交分佈；一個將 5% 機率分配給原地合約的提示被突變觀察者區分，而下游距離保持在預測界限內。<lb/>在 20,000 次隨機有限核試驗中，沒有違反任何精確或近似法則。<lb/>GenOS 是模型參數的：兼容性是一個可測量的屬性來測試，而不是對語言模型行為的假設。
